title: Planning
about: The cards waiting to be started.

terms.meaning: an idea on its way to a run: a short markdown brief in the inbox, started as a run, and kept there after it starts. It names its factory and its workflow, never a repository: the factory's wiring places its run (`nemia factory attach <factory> <workflow> --repo <name>`).

see.label: From a card to a landing

retired.card: inbox: a card names its factory and workflow, never a repository

kept.why: an old card's `repo:` read as written, listed as retired and written back as it was, never to place a run
an old card's `repo:` said as not read at its start (`ignoredRepo`), never to place its run
`nemia inbox queue` prints an old card's `repo:` marked retired, as `nemia inbox` lists it

terms.meaning: a card's name: its file's in the inbox, without its extension, which `nemia inbox` lists and a start names it by.

where a card is in its life: filed, queued or refused before it starts, and its run's phase once it has (pending, running, waiting, succeeded, failed, stopped, cancelled), read from the run each time the inbox is read and never stored on the card; a card whose run was removed reads filed again. Computed once by the orchestrator and sent on the wire as is.

see.label: From a card to a landing

terms.meaning: a card the inbox lists by default: filed, queued or refused, or started with a run that is pending, running or waiting. A card whose run ended is listed with nemia inbox --all, and behind the Inbox page's Ended filter.

see.label: From a card to a landing

terms.meaning: where cards wait before they are started.

see.label: From a card to a landing

terms.meaning: the tick's start of a queued card that did not happen, as it writes it down: when, on which repository, why, and whether it was a refusal.

see.label: From a card to a landing

retired.card: A card keeps its identity after it starts

terms.meaning: the one way a card of the inbox and the tick's tries of a queued one are read and written: `CardDoor` in `packages/agent-orchestrator/src/cards/cards.store.ts`, by `CardName`, its files layer at the store's root a program is given and a memory one, each refusing a card filed under a name that is no card's, at a name taken, or whose text does not read as a card. One run per card is the Run door's to hold.
